section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses body image as a multidimensional construct and establishes the theoretical framework for examining both negative aspects (appearance dissatisfaction) and positive aspects (body appreciation) of body image in relation to sexual health among adult women. The authors define body appreciation as a positive body image concept distinct from the absence of negative body image, and indicate that the present study was designed to explore how appearance dissatisfaction compares to body appreciation in contributing to women's sexual experiences.
